summary: Every mail now says which environment it is about, and the menus are easier to scan.

fixes.title: Every mail names its environment
fixes.text: Mail subjects start with the environment's name, and every mail ends with the environment, tenant, PIM Manager version and a link to it.

fixes.title: Shorter, clearer menus
fixes.text: Audit & Settings is now three menus: Templates, Operations and Settings.
